item.title: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi o Suru’s Hot Gyaru Marin Kitagawa Gets Another Cosplay Figurine
item.description: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi o Suru’s titular gyaru cosplayer Marin has predictably obtained yet another breath-taking figurine, this time dressing her as Shizuku Kuroe and demonstrating a fine level of detail and beauty that will make any collector envious.

item.title: Anime Director Told Voice Actress to Play an “Irredeemable Bitch”
item.description: Voice actress Akira Sekine revealed that the director of Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu gave her some unusually blunt instructions for portraying a character audiences weren’t supposed to sympathize with.

item.title: Genshin Impact Developer Creates AI That Can Play Games for You
item.description: miHoYo has unveiled an AI capable of playing Honkai: Star Rail using only screenshots and keyboard and mouse commands, potentially paving the way for automated game testing and other applications.

item.title: Upcoming Re:Zero Season 5 Promising Yet More Suffering
item.description: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- has officially been renewed for a fifth anime season, and series creator Tappei Nagatsuki is already promising that things are about to get considerably worse for the protagonist (a trend that has been ceaseless since the first season).

item.title: 13 Arrested in China for Selling Fake Tifa Figures at Higher Prices Than Originals
item.description: Chinese police have arrested 13 individuals accused of operating a counterfeit Final Fantasy VII figure business, with the suspects allegedly selling unauthorized Tifa Lockhart merchandise for prices considerably higher than the genuine products and generating over 2 million yuan ($280,000) in sa…

item.title: Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi Season 2 Trailer More Chaotic Than Usual
item.description: Mischievous demon girl Kanan will be returning for more romantic misadventures as Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi’s new second season trailer has teased some of the chaos viewers can expect, with many likely hoping for more sexy moments.

item.title: Youjo Senki Fan Game Removed After Backlash Over Paid Release
item.description: A truly impressive fan-made game based on The Saga of Tanya the Evil (Youjo Senki) has been removed from sale after Japanese social media users criticized its developer for charging money for an unofficial adaptation of the popular anime and light novel series.

item.title: Chrono Trigger Composer Says Dragon Quest Should End After Akira Toriyama’s Death
item.description: Chrono Trigger composer Yasunori Mitsuda has suggested that Square Enix should consider retiring the Dragon Quest franchise following the death of legendary artist Akira Toriyama, arguing that series creator Yuji Horii would be better off developing an entirely new RPG.

item.title: Evangelion Was “So Good” It Made Takashi Murakami Give Up on Anime
item.description: Renowned Japanese contemporary artist Takashi Murakami has revealed that Neon Genesis Evangelion was so overwhelmingly impressive that it convinced him to abandon his ambitions of working in the anime industry, leaving him feeling despair rather than admiration.

item.title: Former Magazine Model Kanako Kawabata’s Partner Arrested on Suspicion of Murder
item.description: Former “egg” magazine model Kanako Kawabata, credited with popularizing the Japanese slang expression “agepoyo,” was allegedly murdered by her live-in partner, who has been arrested four months after the 36-year-old woman’s death in Tokyo.

item.title: Tokyo Bar Scams Targeting Foreign Tourists Triple as Losses Reach $2.5 Million
item.description: Foreign tourists visiting Tokyo’s notorious Kabukicho entertainment district are increasingly falling victim to fraudulent bars, with complaints of overcharging tripling over the past year and reported financial losses across Shinjuku reaching approximately ¥390 million ($2.5 million).

item.title: TBS Anime Revenue Surges 38% as Overseas Streaming Drives Profit Turnaround
item.description: Japanese broadcaster TBS Television has reported a dramatic turnaround in its anime business, with revenue increasing nearly 38% and gross profit reaching ¥1.175 billion ($7.6 million), thanks largely to strong overseas streaming performance from titles such as The Ramparts of Ice.

item.title: Japan Startup Brain Implant Lets Paralyzed Patients Communicate Through Thoughts
item.description: A Japanese startup is preparing to begin clinical trials of a brain implant that could allow severely paralyzed patients to communicate and operate electronic devices using only their thoughts, with the company hoping to bring the technology to market by 2030.

item.title: Hololive Merchandise Sales Drop 14.5% Following VTuber Graduations
item.description: Hololive production operator Cover Corporation has reported a 14.5% decline in merchandise revenue, with the departures of several VTubers continuing to affect sales, although the company’s increasingly lucrative trading card game business is helping to compensate for the losses.
